verdict.rationale: Concurrency limits are a fair question for a hosted scraping API, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of per-tier concurrent request or session caps, nor of the cost to raise them. The browser sandbox and async batch scraping items describe features, not limits or pricing.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I know the maximum concurrent sessions or requests allowed on my pricing tier and the cost to raise that cap
